Where the archive keeps a run: its setup folder

Source: R/archive.R
knw_archive_setup.Rd

A run's ignored files are kept under tune/<key>/<setup>/, one folder per setup compared side by side (#119). The setup is the four tokens of link's output vocabulary its build logged (cut.acc.grad.flow, from the grade record), each held to link's vocabulary.csv when one is given. A build from before link 0.70.0 logged none and is kept under untokened/<tune run>: its folder is never renamed when its tokens are named later (link#420); the index rows gain them instead. A re-run of a tokened setup overwrites its folder, and the bucket keeps the previous objects as versions.

Usage

knw_archive_setup(record, vocabulary = NULL)

Arguments

record

a grade record (knw_grade_record_read()).

vocabulary

NULL, or link's vocabulary (token and axis columns, link's inst/extdata/vocabulary.csv).

Value

character(1) the setup folder.

Examples

knw_archive_setup(data.frame(token_cut = NA, token_acc = NA, token_grad = NA, token_flow = NA,
                             tune_run = "20261027_0000"))
#> [1] "untokened/20261027_0000"
knw_archive_setup(data.frame(token_cut = "cut-full-top", token_acc = "acc-v1", token_grad = "grad-seg",
                             token_flow = "q-wet-fill", tune_run = "20261101_0000"))
#> [1] "cut-full-top.acc-v1.grad-seg.q-wet-fill"
